instruction: How much does my amazon cart and wishlist cost in total, ignoring potential tax and delivery fees?

arguments.code:
amazon_pw = [a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
print('amazon_password:', amazon_pw)
print('using_username:', 'jasonsimp@gmail.com')
resp = apis.amazon.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)
print('login_resp:', resp)

login_resp = apis.amazon.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password='dO*Pe%O')
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
wishlist = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
print('cart_resp_keys:', cart.keys())
print('cart_resp:', cart)
print('wishlist_resp:', wishlist)

cart_cost = cart['base_cost'] + cart['gift_wrap_fee'] - cart['discount']
wishlist_cost = sum(item['price'] * item.get('quantity',1) for item in wishlist)
print('cart_cost_ignoring_tax_delivery:', cart_cost)
print('wishlist_cost:', wishlist_cost)
print('total:', cart_cost + wishlist_cost)
# show per wishlist item for verification
print('wishlist_items_calc:')
for it in wishlist:
    print(it['product_name'], it['price'], it['quantity'], it['price']*it['quantity'])
